facts: Description gives 1000 ft length, 250 ft extreme width, two 88 by 270 ft courts.
Floor diagram locates central/end pavilions and connecting curtains. Installation labels do not supply measured structural bays.

sources.inspection: Artist read description and visually inspected complete scan31 using shared cache; no second PDF copy made.
sources.limits: Not a construction set or as-built certification; no pixel scale or exact bay/roof-pitch measurement.

locators.subject: New York State Building elevation and first-floor plan; graduated foot scales and dimension chains

sources.rightsEvidence: IA/Gettty metadata possible-copyright-status: NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT. Credit architect, publication and Getty scan. No source image is a runtime asset.
sources.inspection: Both plates visually inspected; plan/elevation plate rendered at 2600 px and plan detail at 5200 px page scale.
facts: Plan shows entrance vestibule, central hall, reception/side rooms, stairs and curved end porches.
Front elevation and photo show symmetrical central entrance, repeated windows/niches, parapets and two capped roof towers.
The original floor-plan sheet includes a graduated scale marked in feet.
sources.limits: Published after the fair, not an 1893 printing. Not a complete construction/as-built set. Some fine dimension numerals are ambiguous; no exact bay dimensions transcribed. Roof-back details remain incompletely evidenced.

sources.title: Official views of the World's Columbian Exposition
sources.creator: C. D. Arnold and H. D. Higinbotham; Department of Photography
sources.kind: Original built photographs in a digitally treated public-domain reproduction
sources.rightsEvidence: 1893 public-domain publication reproduced by Gutenberg with stated ebook license. Preserve attribution; no photo imported as game art.
sources.digitalTreatment: Transcriber records gamma 0.8 adjustment, repairs to obvious specks/voids and resized derivatives; not untouched negatives. Appended 1905 history is a separate later text.
sources.inspection: Artist visually inspected plates43,53,64. Architect additionally inspected plate97 Midway; artist has not independently used that plate for a measurement.
sources.limits: Perspective monochrome views establish visible form and rhythm, not exact pitch, size or original colour. Trees obscure parts of New York ground floor.

sources.rightsEvidence: IA metadata: LOC is unaware of copyright restrictions for this item.
sources.inspection: Report text read; selected original interior photographic plates inspected. No scaled floor plan identified in inspected report.
facts: Architects describe an enlarged/enriched adaptation, not a strict Hancock-house copy.
Account distinguishes apparent granite from staff.
sources.limits: Useful source criticism and secondary form reference. Not the dimensional basis of the first kit; OCR hits for submitted plans do not prove an included scaled plan.
